name: Upsun Cloud
line: Builds Git-connected apps and runs them with managed services.

free.text: 15-day no-card trial; 1 project/2 env, max 4.5 CPU/12 GB RAM; compute billed

cells.regions: 14 app regions; access may vary by org

work.math: €2.409 for CPU + €7.70 for traffic (500k extra requests, 90 GB sent out). Add RAM for 64 MB, €19 project/user fees, 10% support, minus the eligible €19 credit. RAM metering and credit rules are not confirmed. Before tax.

€24.09 CPU + €7.70 traffic (500k extra requests, 90 GB out). Add RAM for 1,920 MB, €19 fees, 10% support, less eligible €19 credit. RAM and credit rules unclear. Allocation, not 100 ms per request, is billed. Before tax.

€54.575 + RAM for 1,920 or 1,408 MB + €0.10 per backup GB a month + internal transfer + €19 fees + 10% support − eligible €19 credit. 7 daily backups. RAM, backup size, transfer and support costs unconfirmed. Before tax.
